name: FWCP Annual Grants and Year-round Grants
summary: Grants to compensate for the impacts of BC Hydro dams on fish, wildlife and their habitat in the Coastal, Columbia and Peace regions of British Columbia. The 2026 annual intake closed November 2; year-round grants are no longer listed as open on the application page.

geography.label: BC Hydro dam watersheds, British Columbia

calls.label: 2026 annual grant intake

deadline.text: Monday, November 2, 4 p.m. PT / 5 p.m. MT

status.quote: Our 2026 annual grant intake closed November 2.

deadline.quote: Our 2026 annual grant intake closed November 2.

calls.note: Columbia accepts only last year's multi-year proponents; Columbia and Peace also needed a notice of intent by 11 Sept. New applicants can in practice apply only in Coastal.

calls.label: Year-round grants (Community Engagement, Land Securement, Seed)
calls.note: The page no longer says applications are accepted any time; it only refers previously approved year-round grantees to grant management.

status.quote: If you have been approved previously for an annual or year-round grant, follow this link to login to our online grant management system to manage your grant and project.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible grant applicants include: First Nations government, communities, and businesses; consultants, agencies, non-government organizations, local governments, individuals, and academic institutions.

geography.quote: The FWCP was established to compensate for impacts to fish, wildlife, and their supporting habitat, resulting from the construction of BC Hydro dams.

access.quote: Who can apply for an FWCP grant? Eligible grant applicants include: First Nations government, communities, and businesses; consultants, agencies, non-government organizations, local governments, individuals, and academic institutions.

window.quote: What's coming in 2027: We're in the process of renewing our approach to project funding and will be implementing changes for our annual grant intake that opens in 2027.
